```{r}
# R script to combine NAICS 55 and 56 into a new category - FIXED VERSION
# Created: April 1, 2025

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# Read the dataset
data <- read_csv("~/Documents/GitHub/h1b-econ-paper/improved_processed_data_for_analysis_April1st.csv")

# Create a copy of the original dataset
data_original <- data

# Filter out rows with NAICS codes 55 and 56
data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(naics_2digit != "55" & naics_2digit != 55 & 
         naics_2digit != "56" & naics_2digit != 56)

# Process the data for NAICS 55 and 56 by year
combined_data <- data %>%
  filter(naics_2digit == "55" | naics_2digit == 55 | 
         naics_2digit == "56" | naics_2digit == 56) %>%
  mutate(naics_2digit = as.character(naics_2digit)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(
    # New NAICS code
    naics_2digit = "55-56",
    
    # Sum the applications and approvals/denials
    initial_approvals = sum(initial_approvals),
    initial_denials = sum(initial_denials),
    continuing_approvals = sum(continuing_approvals),
    continuing_denials = sum(continuing_denials),
    total_approvals = sum(total_approvals),
    total_denials = sum(total_denials),
    total_applications = sum(total_applications),
    
    # Weighted average for denial rate based on total applications
    denial_rate = sum(denial_rate * total_applications) / sum(total_applications),
    
    # Sum employment
    total_employment = sum(total_employment),
    pre_period_employment = sum(pre_period_employment),
    
    # Weighted average for wages based on employment
    AVG_WAGE = sum(AVG_WAGE * total_employment) / sum(total_employment),
    real_wage = sum(real_wage * total_employment) / sum(total_employment),
    log_wage = log(AVG_WAGE),
    log_real_wage = log(real_wage),
    
    # Use common inflation rate
    inflation_rate = first(inflation_rate),
    
    # Weighted average for H-1B dependency
    h1b_dependency_current = sum(h1b_dependency_current * total_employment) / sum(total_employment),
    h1b_dependency_preperiod = sum(h1b_dependency_preperiod * total_employment) / sum(total_employment),
    avg_preperiod_dependency = sum(avg_preperiod_dependency * total_employment) / sum(total_employment),
    
    # Logical variables - if either is TRUE, set combined to TRUE
    post_treatment = first(post_treatment),
    high_dependency_median = any(high_dependency_median),
    high_dependency_top25 = any(high_dependency_top25),
    high_dependency_top10 = any(high_dependency_top10),
    
    # Calculate DiD variables - safer approach summing the products
    # Instead of using weighted.mean which requires equal lengths
    did_median = if(all(is.na(did_median))) NA_real_ else sum(did_median * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(did_median)], na.rm = TRUE),
    did_top25 = if(all(is.na(did_top25))) NA_real_ else sum(did_top25 * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(did_top25)], na.rm = TRUE),
    did_top10 = if(all(is.na(did_top10))) NA_real_ else sum(did_top10 * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(did_top10)], na.rm = TRUE),
    did_continuous = if(all(is.na(did_continuous))) NA_real_ else sum(did_continuous * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(did_continuous)], na.rm = TRUE),
    triple_int_median = if(all(is.na(triple_int_median))) NA_real_ else sum(triple_int_median * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(triple_int_median)], na.rm = TRUE),
    triple_int_top25 = if(all(is.na(triple_int_top25))) NA_real_ else sum(triple_int_top25 * total_employment, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(total_employment[!is.na(triple_int_top25)], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Factor variables
    naics_factor = "55-56",
    year_factor = first(year_factor),
    
    # New industry category
    industry_category = "Management of Companies and Enterprises and Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services"
  )

# Combine the filtered data with the new combined category
data_combined <- bind_rows(data_filtered, combined_data)

# Sort the data by NAICS code and year
data_combined <- data_combined %>%
  arrange(year, naics_2digit)

# Write the combined dataset to a new CSV file
write_csv(data_combined, "55-56_improved_processed_data_with_combined_naics.csv")

# Generate summary statistics for verification
summary_stats <- data_combined %>%
  filter(naics_2digit == "55-56") %>%
  select(year, naics_2digit, total_employment, AVG_WAGE, h1b_dependency_current, denial_rate)

# Print summary statistics to verify the combination
print(summary_stats)

# Optional: Compare original vs. combined statistics
comparison <- data %>%
  filter(naics_2digit == "55" | naics_2digit == 55 | 
         naics_2digit == "56" | naics_2digit == 56) %>%
  group_by(year, naics_2digit) %>%
  summarize(
    total_employment = sum(total_employment),
    AVG_WAGE = mean(AVG_WAGE),
    h1b_dependency_current = mean(h1b_dependency_current),
    denial_rate = mean(denial_rate),
    .groups = "drop"  # This suppresses the grouping message
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, naics_2digit)

print("Original statistics:")
print(comparison)

# Print success message
cat("\nCombination complete! New combined dataset saved as 'improved_processed_data_with_combined_naics.csv'\n")
```
